name: PSD of epoched data
summary: Computes the power spectral density of epoched MEG/EEG data per channel type (gradiometers, magnetometers, EEG) with the MNE-Python multitaper method, with PSD plots.
description: Reads MNE epochs, computes the multitaper PSD (mne.time_frequency.psd_multitaper) separately for grad, mag and EEG channels within the chosen frequency and time range, averages across epochs, converts to dB and saves one TSV (channels x frequencies) per channel type plus figures. Use it to inspect spectral content of epoched data. Only channel types present in the data produce output.

inputs.description: Epoched MEG/EEG data in MNE -epo.fif format.

outputs.description: psd.tsv with the epoch-averaged gradiometer PSD in dB (channels x frequencies).
psd.tsv with the epoch-averaged magnetometer PSD in dB (channels x frequencies).
psd.tsv with the epoch-averaged EEG PSD in dB, uV^2/Hz (channels x frequencies).
PNG figures of the PSD (psd_mne.png and psd_computed.png).

parameters.description: The bandwidth of the multi taper windowing function in Hz. The default value is a window half-bandwidth of 4.
Use adaptive weights to combine the tapered spectra into PSD (slow, use n_jobs >> 1 to speed up computation).
Only use tapers with more than 90% spectral concentration within bandwidth.
Either “full” or “length” (default). If “full”, the PSD will be normalized by the sampling rate as well as the length of the signal (as in nitime).

options.label: Full
options.description: PSD will be normalized by the length of the signal

options.label: Length
options.description: the PSD will be normalized by the sampling rate as well as the length of the signal

parameters.description: Not read: the code always sets picks to None and processes grad, mag and EEG channels separately.

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
